items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 6:1
items.html: (To the question) What are two kings in one crown? The Tifferet of Ima is the crown of ZA, and when both ascend to the Tifferet of Ima, they use one crown from Ima, and this is done by the inclusion of the Hod of AA in its Netzach.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 6:2
items.html: And to understand this, we must remember what was explained in Part 14 regarding the Mochin of AB of Aba and Ima and ZON — that they are not drawn from the aspect of the Hochma of AA itself. For after the third head, which is the concealed brain (Mocha Stimaa), the upper Essence was sealed in the membrane of the air (Kruma de-Avira), that is, the Hochma of AA was sealed in the membrane so as not to open any more. And the light of Hochma does not shine to the lower ones except through the hairs, called the Mazalot, like the light of the sun that passes through small openings, as the words of the Rav above, page 1549, item 95. See there. And it is called the light of the sun, because in this Hochma that is revealed upon the Mazalot, only Tifferet is discerned as the principal carrier, which is always called by the name of the sun. And this is for the reason explained there, that the GAR of Aba and Ima are attached in the Bina of AA that went outside his head, which is the crown of Aba and Ima, and its nature is always in covered Hassadim, in the secret of “for He delights in mercy”. But only at the time that ZA ascends as MAN, she returns to the head of AA to the aspect of Hochma, in order to bestow Mochin upon ZA. And therefore it is discerned that even now, when she has become Hochma, the principal carrier and sustainer of the light of Hochma within Bina is ZA, who is called Tifferet. And therefore he is compelled to leave his root in the Tifferet of Bina within the head, in order to sustain the light of Hochma in Bina. And were it not for this, she would immediately return to her own aspect, which is covered Hassadim. And the cause of the fall of the nullification was this: know that the Achoraim of Aba and Ima at the time of the breaking were so, for since all the Mochin of that name went out upon the MAN of ZON, and for their sake Bina returned to Hochma and the look of the eyes of Aba and Ima was made, therefore the MAN of ZON remained in them, in the heads of Aba and Ima, as an aspect of existence and standing, as above. And since the vessels of ZON were broken, and they no longer needed the illumination of Hochma, it turned out that the aspect of the MAN of ZON in the heads of Aba and Ima was nullified, and the Mochin of Aba and Ima were also nullified, and they fell to the aspect of the body, as said there at length. See page 513, item 39.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 6:3
items.html: And you see that the principal carrier of the light of Hochma, namely of the stature of AB of the Mazalot, is only Tifferet, and therefore the Rav likens this stature of Hochma to the light of the sun. Also it was explained above that these Mochin of AB are discerned in three divisions, which are Bina, Tifferet, and Malchut, and they are the inheritance and the two crowns (Atrin). For Bina, which returned to be AB and Hochma, is the aspect of the upper Aba and Ima, which in their own aspect are covered Hassadim, as above; but all the stature of Hochma that they draw is only for the sake of ZON, and they are discerned as the aspect of the essence of the lights. And the roots of ZON that remained in them as an aspect of MAN, for the standing and existence of the light of AB, are the two Atrin — Tifferet and Yesod. For the aspect of Tifferet serves in them as a carrier for the illumination of Hochma, as above. And the aspect of Yesod, which is the crown of Gevura, serves in them as a carrier for the aspect of the screens, upon which the coupling of striking is made. As said above, page 1572, in the entry “and therefore” — see there. And therefore the Tifferet of Ima became a crown for ZA, for since ZA remains in the head of Ima in the aspect of Tifferet, which sustains and stands her stature of AB, then under this he is attached and sucks from her Tifferet his Mochin of AB. For this is the rule: the measure of Mochin that the lower one causes to be in the upper one, the lower one also takes in his own place.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 6:4
items.html: And know that the two Atrin mentioned above, which are Tifferet and Yesod, have an equal relation to the Netzach and Hod of AA. For Tifferet, which is the crown of Hassadim, is ZA. And Yesod, which is the crown of Gevura, is the Nukva, that is, the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, as is known. And you already know that ZA is the Netzach of AA, and the Nukva is the Hod of AA, for from the aspect of the vessels, ZA is discerned as Netzach and the Nukva as Hod. And from the aspect of the lights, ZA is discerned as Tifferet and the Nukva as Netzach, because they are drawn from the aspect opposite them in the AB of AK, as above. And therefore, those ZON that serve as MAN in the head of Ima, called Tifferet and Yesod — from the aspect of the vessels, which are drawn from the crown, which is AA, they are for him the aspect of Netzach and Hod. But in the aspect of the coupling drawn from AB, they are called Tifferet and Yesod in the secret of the middle line. And in the aspect of the Partzufim, which are the vessels drawn from AA, they are called Netzach and Hod. And remember this.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 6:5
items.html: And it is known that at the time that ZON ascend as MAN to Aba and Ima, the NHY of AA also ascend with them, as above (Part 14, item 49). See there. And just as the two Atrin were included one in the other in order to draw the Mochin of AB, for the crown of Gevura draws the reflected light, and the crown of Hesed draws the illumination of Hochma, as above in Part 14 — for were it not for their inclusion, the Mochin would not be drawn — so it is also discerned that the Netzach and Hod of AA were also included one in the other, being a single aspect with the two Atrin, as above. And these two kinds of inclusion come as one, for so they are included at the time of the raising of the MAN, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 6:6
items.html: And it was well explained that the cause of the inclusion of the NHY of AA one in the other is the aspect of the coupling made by the two Atrin. In such a way that no Mochin of AB are drawn except through the inclusion of the NHY of AA one in the other, for the coupling of the HGT that draws the stature of Hochma includes them together. And this is discerned as the inclusion of the Hod of AA in its Netzach. For Netzach is the aspect of the crown of Hesed, namely the Tifferet that carries the illumination of Hochma; but in order to draw the reflected light to clothe the stature, the Hod, which is the crown of Gevura, is also included with it. And it turns out that the crown of Gevura does not serve here in the measure of the Hod, which is her restriction, at all, but on the contrary, she draws Hochma, for were it not for the reflected light, the stature would not be drawn, as above. Thus the Hod was included and became of the measure of Netzach, that is, it assists in drawing the light of Hochma. And this is what the Rav says above, page 854, item 58: “with the Ruach, then ZON use one crown”, meaning that both are included in the Netzach of AA and they receive their illumination in one equivalence. See there, and understand this well.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 6:7
items.html: And it was well explained how the inclusion of the crown of Gevura, which is the aspect of the Nukva, in the crown of Hesed, which is the aspect of ZA, also causes the inclusion of the Hod of AA in its Netzach, from where the Partzufim of ZA and the Nukva suck, which are the aspect of their vessels, as above. For the Mochin and the vessels are included as one. And therefore it is found that the Nukva is attached in the Tifferet of Ima, which is the aspect of the root of ZA, remaining there in the head of AA for the existence and standing of the stature of AB of Ima, equally with ZA himself. For were it not for the aspect of the crown of Gevura of the Nukva included there in this Tifferet, this stature would be nullified, for without her share there, the Mochin would not be drawn. And therefore she also takes the Mochin of AB from the Tifferet of Ima, and the Tifferet of Ima became a crown for her, just as it became a crown for ZA. And thus both are found using one crown. And this is what the Rav says in page 791, item 6: “for from the Tifferet of Ima a crown is made for ZA, and when she also ascends up to there and her crown will be in the Tifferet of Ima like his, their crowns will be equal and both will be one, for both will be the aspect of the Tifferet of Ima, which is one Sefira”. That is, as explained, that this is made by the force of the crown of Gevura being included in the crown of Hesed, and the Hod of AA being included in its Netzach. And the Nukva is found to be attached in the Tifferet of Ima and she sustains and stands her Mochin of AB, like ZA, and therefore the Tifferet of Ima became a crown for her, just as it became for ZA. And therefore both use one crown. (Item 38 and Item 6).
